title: Dapa-CKD: A Study to Evaluate the Effect of Dapagliflozin on Renal Outcomes and Cardiovascular Mortality in Patients With Chronic Kidney Disease
condition: chronic kidney disease, with or without type 2 diabetes

criteria.sentence: Provision of signed informed consent prior to any study specific procedures

rule.unevaluable_reason: Informed consent is not in the synthetic records
rule.label: Signed informed consent

criteria.sentence: Female or male aged ≥18 years at the time of consent
eGFR ≥25 and ≤75 mL/min/1.73m2 (CKD-EPI Formula) at visit 1
Evidence of increased albuminuria 3 months or more before visit 1 and UACR ≥200 and ≤5000 mg/g at visit 1

rule.unevaluable_reason: UACR is not in the synthetic data, and the 3-month albuminuria history needs dates
rule.label: UACR 200-5000 mg/g with albuminuria for 3+ months

criteria.sentence: Stable, and for the patient maximum tolerated labelled daily dose, treatment with ACE-I or ARB for at least 4 weeks before visit 1, if not medically contraindicated,

rule.unevaluable_reason: Doses, ARBs, the 4-week treatment window and contraindications are not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Stable max-dose ACE inhibitor or ARB for 4+ weeks

criteria.sentence: Autosomal dominant or autosomal recessive polycystic kidney disease, lupus nephritis or ANCA-associated vasculitis

rule.unevaluable_reason: Polycystic kidney disease, lupus nephritis and ANCA vasculitis are not in the synthetic conditions list
rule.label: Exclude PKD, lupus nephritis or ANCA vasculitis

criteria.sentence: Receiving cytotoxic therapy, immunosuppressive therapy or other immunotherapy for primary or secondary renal disease within 6 months prior to enrolment

rule.unevaluable_reason: Cytotoxic and immunosuppressive drugs are not in the synthetic medication list, and the 6-month window needs dates
rule.label: Exclude renal immunotherapy in last 6 months

rule.unevaluable_reason: Procedures, including transplants, are not in the synthetic data
rule.label: Exclude organ transplant history

criteria.sentence: Receiving therapy with an SGLT2 inhibitor within 8 weeks prior to enrolment or previous intolerance of an SGLT2 inhibitor

rule.unevaluable_reason: SGLT2 inhibitors are not in the synthetic medication list, and the 8-week window needs dates
rule.label: Exclude recent SGLT2 inhibitor use or intolerance

criteria.sentence: New York Heart Association (NYHA) class IV Congestive Heart Failure at the time of enrolment

rule.label: Exclude NYHA class IV heart failure

criteria.sentence: MI, unstable angina, stroke or transient ischemic attack within 12 weeks prior to enrolment

rule.unevaluable_reason: 12-week event window needs dates; the synthetic data has no dates
rule.label: Exclude recent MI/stroke/unstable angina/TIA (12-week window)
